summary.intent: Fix the SDK's uploadFile() hardcoding AES-GCM for all files instead of selecting AES-CTR for large media files, and debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging.
summary.outcome: Both features were implemented and merged: CTR encryption mode selection in the SDK (PR #399) and a new PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint plus load test fixes (PR #400), along with centralizing MIME type logic, fixing pre-existing test type errors across the API, and resolving ESLint scanning Rust build artifacts.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed only in the web app's streaming-crypto.service.ts and was duplicated in the SDK client — centralized into packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts
setByoStatus() was a dead service method with no controller endpoint — BYO mode could never be toggled via API, which was the real root cause of register-cid 400/403 errors
The load test's ipns-publish call sent { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — the signed IPNS record was missing entirely
API test files systematically used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> then re-fetched via module.get(), losing mock method types — the pattern should use the mock object directly without re-fetching
The root target/ directory (Rust build artifacts) was not in ESLint ignores, causing 261 of 262 lint errors to be from Rust-generated JS files
FLAC files (audio/flac) were missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both the SDK client and web app streaming service
The todo pending/ copy was not cleaned up after the PR merged — both pending and done copies existed in main after the merge
.husky/commit-msg and .husky/commit-msg.pre-entire are managed by the Entire CLI tool locally and should be in .git/info/exclude, not committed to the repo

code.finding: New centralized module for CTR/GCM mode selection — selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and normalizeEncryptionMode(mode) exported from sdk-core
uploadFile() now accepts optional encryptionMode param, uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when 'CTR', falls back to GCM
uploadFile() now calls selectEncryptionMode() from sdk-core before uploading, imported rather than duplicating the MIME set
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added — was previously a dead service method with no controller route
SetByoStatusDto (request) and SetByoStatusResponseDto (response) added for the new endpoint
createByoClientPool now enables BYO mode on each account via the new endpoint and filters out accounts where enableByo fails
ipns-publish step replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core; createSdkContext hoisted outside iteration loop
Added 'target/**' to ESLint ignores — was previously only ignoring src-tauri/target/, causing 261 errors from Rust doc/build JS

workflow: When vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core', () => ({ ... })) replaces the entire module, new exports added to sdk-core break all tests using that pattern — use importActual + spread instead
After merging a branch, check that todo pending/ files are cleaned up — the merge brought both pending/ and done/ copies into main
orval API client regeneration creates new model files and directories that must all be staged, not just specific files — use git add packages/api-client/src/ to catch everything
When manually generating OpenAPI spec, write to the correct output path (packages/api-client/openapi.json) not cwd — a stray apps/api/openapi.json was accidentally committed
Entire CLI modifies .husky/commit-msg locally — add it to .git/info/exclude to prevent it showing in git status; the pre-existing commitlint hook should stay in the repo

friction: GraphQL API timed out when fetching review threads — had to fall back to REST API for PR comment fetching
orval generation during api:generate ran against the already-running API server (old build), so the new endpoint wasn't included until rebuilt
Manually-run OpenAPI generation script wrote to cwd (apps/api/openapi.json) instead of the correct packages/api-client/openapi.json, requiring a revert commit
api-client changes from api:generate weren't committed, causing a drift check CI failure — required a separate commit
Pre-existing TypeScript errors across 9 API spec files (jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern) had to be fixed before typecheck passed, expanding scope significantly
Push commands appeared to hang/not complete — required multiple retries and status checks
.husky/commit-msg.pre-entire was in .git/info/exclude locally, making it invisible to git add without --force, causing confusion about the Entire CLI hook chain
open_items: The one remaining ESLint warning: @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any in apps/api/src/ipns/delegated-routing.client.spec.ts:60
integration.test.ts in packages/sdk fails with live API errors — pre-existing, not addressed

13 other pending todos remain including: Web Worker for large file encryption, ERC-1271 contract wallet auth, CRDT-based IPNS inbox, async search index build, alternative MFA factors, mock-ipns-routing removal
BYO load test baselines on staging still need to be run now that the register-cid 400 bug is fixed
The PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint is not yet wired into the web app Settings UI — the UI still can't toggle BYO mode for end users
